briefing: Markets were mildly negative today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a neutral-to-soft session rather than a risk-off one. Rather than force capital into weaker names, we made one high-conviction buy in FRVO, the only candidate showing all four confirming signals (RSI, MACD crossover, price vs SMA-20, and volume surge), and held the rest of the portfolio and remaining cash for a clearer risk-on signal.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a buy when several independent technical indicators agree at once — for example RSI in a healthy range, a MACD bullish crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge together. Relying on just one signal can be misleading, but when four line up together it suggests real buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重信號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標同時發出一致訊號時才進行買入,例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價站上均線,以及成交量放大。單一信號容易造成誤判,但當四項指標同時吻合時,通常代表真實的買盤力道,而非隨機波動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the S&P 500 down 0.3% and the NASDAQ down 0.6%, a mild pullback rather than a sharp reversal. Without a specific catalyst reported, this looks like routine consolidation after recent gains rather than a change in trend. Broad market breadth stayed roughly neutral, which is why individual stock-level setups mattered more than the index-level move today.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅走弱,標普500指數下跌0.3%,納指下跌0.6%,屬溫和回調而非急轉直下。目前未見明確的利空消息,較像是近期漲勢後的正常整固,而非趨勢逆轉。大盤氣氛維持中性,因此今日個股層面的技術信號比大盤走勢更具參考價值。

trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (RSI 66.3 bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) marks a genuine institutional-grade setup worth deploying into despite the neutral broader market.
